# AS 
```{r, function: calculate_average}
calculate_average <- function(column) {
  split_counts <- strsplit(as.character(column), ",")

  sapply(split_counts, function(x) {
    values <- as.numeric(x)
    if (all(is.na(values))) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    mean(values, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}
```
```{r, function: process_rmats}
process_rmats <- function(comparison, event_type) {

  # Define the input file path
  file_path <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    comparison,
    "output_rmats",
    paste0(event_type, ".MATS.JCEC.txt")
  )

  # Read rMATS output
  df <- read.delim(
    file_path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Remove gene ID version numbers
  df$GeneID <- gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", df$GeneID)

  # Add gene annotation
  df <- df %>%
    left_join(gene_infor, by = c("GeneID" = "gene"))

  # Calculate mean read counts and inclusion levels
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      IJC_SAMPLE_1_mean = calculate_average(IJC_SAMPLE_1),
      SJC_SAMPLE_1_mean = calculate_average(SJC_SAMPLE_1),
      IJC_SAMPLE_2_mean = calculate_average(IJC_SAMPLE_2),
      SJC_SAMPLE_2_mean = calculate_average(SJC_SAMPLE_2),
      IncLevel1_mean = calculate_average(IncLevel1),
      IncLevel2_mean = calculate_average(IncLevel2),
      AS_type = event_type,
      Comparison = comparison
    )

  return(df)
}
```

```{r, load data and significant}
  oo_A5SS,
  oo_A3SS,

filter_AS <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    filter(
      PValue < 0.05,
      abs(IncLevelDifference) > 0.1,
      IJC_SAMPLE_1_mean > 5 |
      SJC_SAMPLE_1_mean > 5 |
      IJC_SAMPLE_2_mean > 5 |
      SJC_SAMPLE_2_mean > 5
    )
}

oo_AS_sig <- filter_AS(oo_AS)

cell256_AS_sig <- filter_AS(cell256_AS)

all_AS_sig <- bind_rows(
  oo_AS_sig,
  cell256_AS_sig
)
```

## overlap
```{r, function: find_AS_overlap}
find_AS_overlap <- function(event_type) {

  # Define event-specific matching columns
  keys <- match_columns[[event_type]]

  # Select significant events from each stage
  oo_data <- oo_AS_sig %>%
    filter(AS_type == event_type) %>%
    select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))) | all_of(keys))

  cell256_data <- cell256_AS_sig %>%
    filter(AS_type == event_type) %>%
    select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))) | all_of(keys))

  # Identify shared significant events
  overlap <- inner_join(
    oo_data,
    cell256_data,
    by = keys,
    suffix = c("_oo", "_256cell"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      AS_type = event_type,
      Direction = case_when(
        IncLevelDifference_oo > 0 &
          IncLevelDifference_256cell > 0 ~ "Both_positive",

        IncLevelDifference_oo < 0 &
          IncLevelDifference_256cell < 0 ~ "Both_negative",

        TRUE ~ "Opposite_direction"
      )
    )

  return(overlap)
}
```
```{r, define columns for matching and Identify overlapping events}
match_columns <- list(
  SE = c(
    "GeneID", "chr", "strand",
    "exonStart_0base", "exonEnd",
    "upstreamES", "upstreamEE",
    "downstreamES", "downstreamEE"
  ),

  A5SS = c(
    "GeneID", "chr", "strand",
    "longExonStart_0base", "longExonEnd",
    "shortES", "shortEE",
    "flankingES", "flankingEE"
  ),

  A3SS = c(
    "GeneID", "chr", "strand",
    "longExonStart_0base", "longExonEnd",
    "shortES", "shortEE",
    "flankingES", "flankingEE"
  ),

  MXE = c(
    "GeneID", "chr", "strand",
    "X1stExonStart_0base", "X1stExonEnd",
    "X2ndExonStart_0base", "X2ndExonEnd",
    "upstreamES", "upstreamEE",
    "downstreamES", "downstreamEE"
  ),

  RI = c(
    "GeneID", "chr", "strand",
    "riExonStart_0base", "riExonEnd",
    "upstreamES", "upstreamEE",
    "downstreamES", "downstreamEE"
  )
)

SE_Overlap   <- find_AS_overlap("SE")
A5SS_Overlap <- find_AS_overlap("A5SS")
A3SS_Overlap <- find_AS_overlap("A3SS")
MXE_Overlap  <- find_AS_overlap("MXE")
RI_Overlap   <- find_AS_overlap("RI")

all_AS_Overlap <- bind_rows(
  SE_Overlap,
  A5SS_Overlap,
  A3SS_Overlap,
  MXE_Overlap,
  RI_Overlap
)

table(all_AS_Overlap$AS_type)

nrow(all_AS_Overlap)

n_distinct(all_AS_Overlap$GeneID)
```

```{r, AS_overlap_summary}
AS_overlap_summary <- data.frame(
  AS_type = c("SE", "A5SS", "A3SS", "MXE", "RI")
) %>%
  left_join(
    oo_AS_sig %>%
      count(AS_type, name = "Oocyte"),
    by = "AS_type"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cell256_AS_sig %>%
      count(AS_type, name = "Cell256"),
    by = "AS_type"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    all_AS_Overlap %>%
      count(AS_type, name = "Shared"),
    by = "AS_type"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(Oocyte, Cell256, Shared),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
    ),
    Oocyte_only = Oocyte - Shared,
    Cell256_only = Cell256 - Shared,
    Total_unique = Oocyte + Cell256 - Shared,
    Shared_percentage = round(
      Shared / Total_unique * 100, 2
    )
  )

AS_overlap_summary
```

```{r, p_AS_overlap}
library(ggplot2)

p_AS_overlap <- ggplot(
  all_AS_Overlap,
  aes(
    x = IncLevelDifference_oo,
    y = IncLevelDifference_256cell,
    color = AS_type
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey60"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey60"
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    x = expression(Delta * "PSI in oocytes"),
    y = expression(Delta * "PSI in 256-cell embryos"),
    color = "AS type"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

p_AS_overlap

cor.test(
  all_AS_Overlap$IncLevelDifference_oo,
  all_AS_Overlap$IncLevelDifference_256cell,
  method = "pearson"
)


AS_correlation <- all_AS_Overlap %>%
  group_by(AS_type) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Pearson_r = cor(
      IncLevelDifference_oo,
      IncLevelDifference_256cell,
      method = "pearson"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

AS_correlation
```
